aspect: The route, the time and the clothing are all decisions
description: Which bus, which hour, which market, what to wear, whether to travel alone. A planning overhead applied to every journey and paid by half the population.
energy_note: Three decisions before leaving the house, every time.

description: A taxi instead of a bus, a hired driver, a route with more light. Safety is purchasable, which means it is income-tiered.
energy_note: Buying the safer journey, by the trip.

aspect: And the restriction is internalised as preference
description: After enough years the person describes not going out at night as something she does not enjoy rather than something she has stopped doing. The constraint disappears into the personality.
energy_note: A restriction that has learned to call itself a preference.

description: The 7.40 gets her home in daylight. The 8.20 does not. She leaves work at 7.15 every day regardless of what is unfinished, and has done for six years, and it has been noticed in two appraisals as a lack of commitment.
energy_note: Marked down, annually, for catching the earlier bus.
